name: robots/heleidsn__uav_navigation_drl_airsim
title: UAV Navigation DRL AirSim (NH_center, SimpleMultirotor 3D)
intro: UAV Navigation DRL AirSim (NH_center, SimpleMultirotor 3D), adapted from heleidsn/uav_navigation_drl_airsim. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
